claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is also known as WrestleMania Vegas.
WrestleMania 42 is the 42nd annual event.
WrestleMania 42 is a two-night event.
Tickets for WrestleMania 42 are available via Ticketmaster.
Premium hospitality packages for WrestleMania 42 are available via On Location.
The location of 2026 WrestleMania is Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas (Paradise, NV).
The dates of 2026 WrestleMania are Saturday, April 18 and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
John Cena is the host of 2026 WrestleMania.
CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns is a confirmed or rumored match for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton is a confirmed or rumored match for the Undisputed WWE Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Rhea Ripley vs. Jade Cargill is a confirmed or rumored match for the WWE Women’s Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Stephanie Vaquer vs. Liv Morgan is a confirmed or rumored match for the Women's World Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Brock Lesnar vs. Oba Femi is a confirmed or rumored special attraction at WrestleMania 42.
AJ Lee vs. Becky Lynch is a potential bout for the Women’s Intercontinental Title at WrestleMania 42.
Drew McIntyre vs. Jacob Fatu is a potential unsanctioned bout at WrestleMania 42.
WrestleMania week in Las Vegas includes the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony.
Monday Night Raw is scheduled in Las Vegas during WrestleMania week 2026.
Friday Night SmackDown is scheduled in Las Vegas during WrestleMania week 2026.
WWE World is a multi-day interactive fan experience produced with Fanatics Events.
NXT Stand & Deliver is part of WrestleMania week in Las Vegas.
On Location Hospitality includes pre-show events with superstar appearances for WrestleMania 42.
On Location Hospitality includes sessions with Oba Femi, Jordynne Grace, and Je'Von Evans.
Official tickets for WrestleMania 42 are available now at Ticketmaster.
On Location is the official partner for VIP tickets to WrestleMania 42.
On Location VIP ticket packages for WrestleMania 42 offer ringside seats and premium hospitality.
On Location VIP ticket packages for WrestleMania 42 begin around $825.
